summary: Elon AB (publ) operates a chain of consumer electronics stores in the Nordic countries. The company operates through three segments: Business to Consumer, Business to Business, and Solutions. The company offers white goods, kitchens, and communication solutions; cooling and heating products; and warehousing, logistics, freight contract, IT, and payment solutions. It operates through Elon, Elon Ljud & Bild, Nordanro Studio, RingUp, Elvita, and Canvac brand names. The company sells its products through a network of stores, as well as web platforms. The company was founded in 1949 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden. Elon AB (publ) operates as a subsidiary of Elon Group Holding AB (publ).
